defmodule ChatServer.Auth do
  @moduledoc "Authentication module for real-time chat server"

  @max_failures 5
  @reset_timeout 30_000
  @token_length 32

  defstruct [:state, :failure_count, :last_failure_at, :tokens]

  def new do
    %__MODULE__{
      state: :closed,
      failure_count: 0,
      last_failure_at: nil,
      tokens: %{}
    }
  end

  def verify_token(circuit, token, stored_hash) do
    case check_circuit(circuit) do
      {:ok, circuit} ->
        result = constant_time_compare(token, stored_hash)
        circuit = update_circuit(circuit, result)
        {result, circuit}

      {:open, circuit} ->
        {:circuit_open, circuit}
    end
  end

  defp check_circuit(%{state: :open, last_failure_at: last} = circuit) do
    if System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) - last > @reset_timeout do
      {:ok, %{circuit | state: :half_open}}
    else
      {:open, circuit}
    end
  end

  defp check_circuit(%{state: state} = circuit) when state in [:closed, :half_open] do
    {:ok, circuit}
  end

  defp update_circuit(circuit, true) do
    %{circuit | state: :closed, failure_count: 0}
  end

  defp update_circuit(circuit, false) do
    new_count = circuit.failure_count + 1
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)

    if new_count >= @max_failures do
      %{circuit | state: :open, failure_count: new_count, last_failure_at: now}
    else
      %{circuit | failure_count: new_count, last_failure_at: now}
    end
  end

  defp constant_time_compare(input, stored) when is_binary(input) and is_binary(stored) do
    input_hash = :crypto.hash(:sha256, input)
    compare_digests(input_hash, stored, byte_size(stored))
  end

  defp compare_digests(left, right, len) do
    left_bytes = :binary.bin_to_list(left)
    right_bytes = :binary.bin_to_list(right)

    left_padded = Enum.take(left_bytes ++ List.duplicate(0, len), len)
    right_padded = Enum.take(right_bytes ++ List.duplicate(0, len), len)

    result =
      Enum.zip(left_padded, right_padded)
      |> Enum.reduce(0, fn {a, b}, acc -> Bitwise.bor(acc, Bitwise.bxor(a, b)) end)

    result == 0
  end
end

defmodule ChatServer.Room do
  @moduledoc "Chat room with authenticated message delivery"

  use GenServer

  defstruct [:name, :members, :auth_circuit, :message_log]

  def start_link(name) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, name, name: via(name))
  end

  def send_message(room, user_token, message) do
    GenServer.call(via(room), {:send_message, user_token, message})
  end

  def join(room, user_id, token_hash) do
    GenServer.call(via(room), {:join, user_id, token_hash})
  end

  @impl true
  def init(name) do
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{
      name: name,
      members: %{},
      auth_circuit: ChatServer.Auth.new(),
      message_log: []
    }}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:join, user_id, token_hash}, _from, state) do
    members = Map.put(state.members, user_id, %{token_hash: token_hash, joined_at: DateTime.utc_now()})
    {:reply, :ok, %{state | members: members}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:send_message, user_token, message}, _from, state) do
    {auth_result, member_id} = authenticate_sender(state, user_token)

    case auth_result do
      {true, new_circuit} ->
        entry = %{from: member_id, body: message, at: DateTime.utc_now()}
        new_state = %{state | auth_circuit: new_circuit, message_log: [entry | state.message_log]}
        {:reply, {:ok, :delivered}, new_state}

      {false, new_circuit} ->
        {:reply, {:error, :unauthorized}, %{state | auth_circuit: new_circuit}}

      {:circuit_open, new_circuit} ->
        {:reply, {:error, :rate_limited}, %{state | auth_circuit: new_circuit}}
    end
  end

  defp authenticate_sender(state, user_token) do
    Enum.reduce_while(state.members, {nil, nil}, fn {user_id, member}, _acc ->
      {result, new_circuit} = ChatServer.Auth.verify_token(
        state.auth_circuit, user_token, member.token_hash
      )
      case result do
        true -> {:halt, {{true, new_circuit}, user_id}}
        false -> {:cont, {{false, new_circuit}, user_id}}
        :circuit_open -> {:halt, {{:circuit_open, new_circuit}, nil}}
      end
    end)
  end

  defp via(name), do: {:via, Registry, {ChatServer.Registry, name}}
end
